# hydo Milestone 97: syzkaller description of /dev/hvx, the hvx VT-x module's ioctl interface.
# Source of truth: hv/hvx/hvx_abi.h. The constants (ioctl numbers, flags, struct sizes) are in
# dev_hvx.txt.const, generated by gen-const.c from that header; build-syzkaller.sh copies
# both files into syzkaller's sys/linux/ and checks the struct sizes below against the C ones.
# syz_ext_hvx_guest is defined in common_ext.h (syzkaller's extension point).

resource fd_hvx[fd]

openat$hvx(fd const[AT_FDCWD], file ptr[in, string["/dev/hvx"]], flags flags[hvx_open_flags], mode const[0]) fd_hvx
mmap$hvx(addr vma, len len[addr], prot flags[mmap_prot], flags flags[mmap_flags], fd fd_hvx, offset flags[hvx_mmap_offset])

# Writes a structured guest program at GPA 0x3000 (where RIP starts) plus extra guest-memory writes.
syz_ext_hvx_guest(fd fd_hvx, flags flags[hvx_guest_flags], ops ptr[in, array[hvx_gop, 0:32]], nops len[ops], mem ptr[in, array[hvx_gmem, 0:8]], nmem len[mem])

ioctl$HVX_CREATE_VM(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_CREATE_VM], arg ptr[in, hvx_config])
ioctl$HVX_CREATE_VM_edge(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_CREATE_VM], arg ptr[in, hvx_config_edge])
ioctl$HVX_SET_REGS(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_REGS], arg ptr[in, hvx_regs])
ioctl$HVX_GET_REGS(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_REGS], arg ptr[out, hvx_regs])
ioctl$HVX_RUN(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_RUN], arg ptr[out, hvx_exit])
ioctl$HVX_RUNC(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_RUNC], arg ptr[inout, hvx_run_ctl])
ioctl$HVX_SET_TSC(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_TSC], arg ptr[in, hvx_tsc])
ioctl$HVX_GET_TSC(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_TSC], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_tsc]])
ioctl$HVX_GET_SNAPSHOT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_SNAPSHOT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_snapshot]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_SNAPSHOT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_SNAPSHOT], arg ptr[in, hvx_snapshot])
ioctl$HVX_INJECT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_INJECT], arg ptr[in, hvx_inject])
ioctl$HVX_GET_CONSOLE(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_CONSOLE], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_console]])
ioctl$HVX_GET_SREGS(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_SREGS], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_sregs]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_SREGS(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_SREGS], arg ptr[in, hvx_sregs])
ioctl$HVX_PUT_INPUT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_PUT_INPUT], arg ptr[in, hvx_input])
ioctl$HVX_SET_VCPU(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_VCPU], arg ptr[in, int32[0:9]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_DISK(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_DISK], arg ptr[in, hvx_disk_set])
ioctl$HVX_SET_DISK_edge(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_DISK], arg ptr[in, hvx_disk_edge])
ioctl$HVX_GET_DISK(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_DISK], arg ptr[inout, hvx_disk_get])
ioctl$HVX_SET_FAULT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_FAULT], arg ptr[in, hvx_fault])
ioctl$HVX_GET_FAULT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_FAULT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_fault]])
ioctl$HVX_NET_ATTACH(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_NET_ATTACH], arg ptr[in, hvx_net_config])
ioctl$HVX_PUT_RX(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_PUT_RX], arg ptr[in, hvx_rx])
ioctl$HVX_GET_TX(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_TX], arg ptr[inout, hvx_tx])
ioctl$HVX_SET_NET_FAULT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_NET_FAULT], arg ptr[in, hvx_net_fault])
ioctl$HVX_GET_NET_FAULT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_NET_FAULT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_net_fault]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_FUZZ_INPUT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_FUZZ_INPUT], arg ptr[in, hvx_fuzz_input])
ioctl$HVX_SET_PMU(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_PMU], arg ptr[in, hvx_pmu])
ioctl$HVX_GET_PMU(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_PMU], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_pmu]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_PT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_PT], arg ptr[in, hvx_pt_config])
ioctl$HVX_GET_PT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_PT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_pt_status]])
ioctl$HVX_READ_PT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_READ_PT], arg ptr[in, hvx_pt_read])
ioctl$HVX_SET_TJITTER(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_TJITTER], arg ptr[in, hvx_tjitter])
ioctl$HVX_GET_TJITTER(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_TJITTER], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_tjitter]])
ioctl$HVX_GET_UNSYNC(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_UNSYNC], arg ptr[inout, hvx_unsync_get])
ioctl$HVX_SET_UNSYNC(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_UNSYNC], arg ptr[in, hvx_unsync_set])
ioctl$HVX_SET_XTICK(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_XTICK], arg ptr[in, hvx_xtick])
ioctl$HVX_GET_XTICK(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_XTICK], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_xtick]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_FLUSHCUT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_FLUSHCUT], arg ptr[in, hvx_flushcut])
ioctl$HVX_GET_FLUSHCUT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_FLUSHCUT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_flushcut]])
ioctl$HVX_GET_SCHED(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_SCHED], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_sched]])
ioctl$HVX_SET_SCHED(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_SCHED], arg ptr[in, hvx_sched])
ioctl$HVX_GET_FTSTAT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_FTSTAT], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_ftstat]])
ioctl$HVX_RESET_FTSTAT(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_RESET_FTSTAT], arg const[0])
ioctl$HVX_SET_TURNCTL(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_SET_TURNCTL], arg ptr[in, hvx_turnctl])
ioctl$HVX_GET_TURNCTL(fd fd_hvx, cmd const[HVX_GET_TURNCTL], arg ptr[out, array[int8, HVX_SIZEOF_hvx_turnctl]])

hvx_open_flags = O_RDWR, O_CLOEXEC
hvx_mmap_offset = 0, HVX_DISK_MMAP_OFFSET
hvx_guest_flags = 1, 2
hvx_vm_flags = HVX_VM_IDLE_HEARTBEAT, HVX_VM_X86_64_V2, HVX_VM_PMU_CLOCK, HVX_VM_PAUSE_EXIT, HVX_VM_PT_TRACE, HVX_VM_SMP_SCHED, HVX_VM_SMP_BOOT, HVX_VM_X86_64_V3
hvx_run_flags = HVX_RUN_SINGLE_STEP, HVX_RUN_RESET_ICOUNT
hvx_tsc_mode = HVX_TSC_COUNTER, HVX_TSC_ICOUNT
hvx_disk_flags = HVX_DISK_NO_IDMAP
hvx_net_flags = HVX_NET_NO_IDMAP, HVX_NET_PACED
hvx_fault_classes = HVX_FAULT_DELAY, HVX_FAULT_ERROR, HVX_FAULT_DROP, HVX_FAULT_REORDER, HVX_FAULT_TORN, HVX_FAULT_DROP_UNFLUSHED
hvx_nfault_classes = HVX_NFAULT_DROP, HVX_NFAULT_DELAY, HVX_NFAULT_CORRUPT, HVX_NFAULT_DUPLICATE, HVX_NFAULT_REORDER
hvx_pt_flags = HVX_PT_KERNEL, HVX_PT_USER, HVX_PT_CR3, HVX_PT_NORETCOMP

# Guest RAM is bounded to 8 MiB (four EPT page tables) so a fuzzing VM with many open VMs does
# not run out of memory; the _edge
# variant covers the size checks (0, just above the 3 GiB cap, huge). The cap itself (3 GiB)
# is left out: in a 2 GiB fuzzing VM it exhausts memory and the OOM killer takes the run
# (hvx_repro bigalloc covers that path in the debug VM).
hvx_config {
	mem_size	int64[0:0x800000]
	n_vcpus		int32[0:9]
	flags		flags[hvx_vm_flags, int32]
}
hvx_config_edge {
	mem_size	flags[hvx_edge_mem, int64]
	n_vcpus		flags[hvx_edge_vcpus, int32]
	flags		int32
}
hvx_edge_mem = 0, 1, 0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xc0000001, 0xfe000000, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0x8000000000000000
hvx_edge_vcpus = 0, 1, 8, 9, 0xffffffff

hvx_regs {
	gpr	array[int64, 15]
	rip	flags[hvx_guest_addr, int64]
	rsp	flags[hvx_guest_addr, int64]
	rflags	flags[hvx_rflags, int64]
}
hvx_guest_addr = 0x3000, 0x3001, 0x0, 0x1000, 0x7ff0, 0x3fff0, 0xfffff000, 0xfe000000, 0xffffffff80000000, 0xffffffffffffffff
hvx_rflags = 0x2, 0x202, 0x302, 0x40202, 0x100, 0x200, 0x4000

hvx_exit {
	reason		int32
	insn_len	int32
	qual		int64
	gpa		int64
}

hvx_run_ctl {
	flags		flags[hvx_run_flags, int64]
	max_insns	int64[0:4096]
	icount		int64
	qual		int64
	gpa		int64
	reason		int32
	insn_len	int32
}

hvx_tsc {
	tsc	int64
	step	int64
	aux	int64
	count	int64
	mode	flags[hvx_tsc_mode, int64]
}

hvx_segment {
	base		int64
	limit		int32
	selector	int16
	ar		int16
}

hvx_sregs {
	cr0		flags[hvx_cr0, int64]
	cr3		int64
	cr4		flags[hvx_cr4, int64]
	efer		flags[hvx_efer, int64]
	dr7		int64
	cs		hvx_segment
	ss		hvx_segment
	ds		hvx_segment
	es		hvx_segment
	fs		hvx_segment
	gs		hvx_segment
	tr		hvx_segment
	ldtr		hvx_segment
	gdt_base	int64
	idt_base	int64
	gdt_limit	int32
	idt_limit	int32
}
hvx_cr0 = 0x80050033, 0x80000011, 0x60000010, 0x1, 0x0, 0x80000001
hvx_cr4 = 0x20, 0x2020, 0x620, 0x40620, 0x0, 0x40000
hvx_efer = 0x500, 0xd01, 0x0, 0x100, 0x400

hvx_inject {
	vector		int32[0:300]
	type		int32[0:1]
	at_icount	int64
}

hvx_input {
	len	int32[0:300]
	buf	array[int8, 256]
}

hvx_disk_set {
	len	flags[hvx_disk_sizes, int64]
	data	ptr64[in, array[int8, 0:4096], opt]
	flags	flags[hvx_disk_flags, int64]
}
hvx_disk_sizes = 512, 4096, 8192, 65536, 0x100000, 0x400001
hvx_disk_edge {
	len	flags[hvx_disk_edge_sizes, int64]
	data	const[0, int64]
	flags	flags[hvx_disk_flags, int64]
}
hvx_disk_edge_sizes = 0, 1, 0x100000001, 0xffffffffffffffff
hvx_disk_get {
	len	len[data, int64]
	data	ptr64[out, array[int8, 0:8192]]
	flags	int64
}

hvx_fault {
	seed		int64
	classes		flags[hvx_fault_classes, int32]
	probability	int32[0:101]
	max_delay	int32
	pad		const[0, int32]
	req_seq		int64
	fault_count	int64
}

hvx_net_config {
	mac	array[int8, 6]
	pad	const[0, int16]
	flags	flags[hvx_net_flags, int64]
}

hvx_rx {
	len	int32[0:1537]
	buf	array[int8, 1536]
}

hvx_tx {
	len	len[data, int64]
	data	ptr64[out, array[int8, 0:9000]]
	count	int64
}

hvx_net_fault {
	seed		int64
	classes		flags[hvx_nfault_classes, int32]
	probability	int32[0:101]
	max_delay	int32
	pad		const[0, int32]
	rx_seq		int64
	tx_seq		int64
	fault_count	int64
}

hvx_fuzz_input {
	len	int32[0:9000]
	buf	array[int8, 8192]
}

hvx_pmu {
	period		int64[0:2000000]
	tick_tsc	int64
	rest		array[int64, 7]
}

hvx_pt_config {
	buf_mib	int64[0:4]
	flags	flags[hvx_pt_flags, int32]
	pad	const[0, int32]
	cr3	int64
	lo	array[int64, 2]
	hi	array[int64, 2]
}

hvx_pt_read {
	offset	int64
	len	len[addr, int64]
	addr	ptr64[out, array[int8, 0:4096]]
}

hvx_tj_pair {
	tick	int64
	delay	int64
}
hvx_tjitter {
	seed		int64
	max_delay	int64
	permille	int32[0:1001]
	n_explicit	int32[0:33]
	tick_lo		int64
	tick_hi		int64
	explicit	array[hvx_tj_pair, 32]
	applied		int64
	applied_hash	int64
	last_tick	int64
}

# GET: the caller's buffer may be too small (ENOSPC path).
hvx_unsync_get {
	addr	ptr64[out, array[int8, 0:16416]]
	len	len[addr, int64]
	n	int32
	pad	const[0, int32]
}
hvx_unsync_rec {
	doff	flags[hvx_doff, int64]
	len	int32[0:8193]
	valid	int32[0:1]
}
hvx_doff = 0, 512, 4096, 0xfffffe00, 0xfffffffffffff000, 0xfffffffffffffe00, 0x7fffffffffffffff
hvx_unsync_blob {
	recs	array[hvx_unsync_rec, 2]
	data	array[int8, 16416]
}
hvx_unsync_set {
	addr	ptr64[in, hvx_unsync_blob]
	len	flags[hvx_unsync_len, int64]
	n	int32[0:3]
	pad	const[0, int32]
}
hvx_unsync_len = 0, 8208, 16416, 16448, 0xffffffffffffffff

hvx_xtick {
	seed		int64
	rate		int32[0:65]
	permille	int32[0:1001]
	lo		int64
	hi		int64
	tsc		int64
	n_explicit	int32[0:33]
	pad		const[0, int32]
	explicit	array[int64, 32]
	applied		int64
	applied_hash	int64
	first		int64
	last		int64
}

hvx_flushcut {
	on	int32[0:1]
	off	int32
	target	int64[0:8]
	count	int64
	lo	int64
	hi	int64
	hung	int64
	pad	array[int64, 2]
}

	quantum		int64[0:100000]

	stop_turn	int64[0:10]
	pause_k		int32
	n_vcpus		int32

}

hvx_turnctl {
	margin		int64[0:2000000]
	burst_seed	int64
	burst_len	int64[0:100000]
	burst_q		int64[0:100000]
	burst_permille	int32[0:1001]
	pad0		const[0, int32]
	burst_window	int64[0:100000]
	stats		array[int64, 6]
}

# The full snapshot: every field the module restores from userspace (HVX_SET_SNAPSHOT trusts
# it, so this is where unchecked indexes and lengths would hide).
hvx_snapshot {
	regs			hvx_regs
	tsc			int64
	tsc_step		int64
	tsc_aux			int64
	tsc_mode		flags[hvx_tsc_mode, int64]
	icount			int64
	rdtsc_count		int64
	inject_at_icount	int64
	inject_vector		int32
	inject_valid		int32[0:1]
	n_guest_pages		int64
	sw_msr			array[int64, 11]
	sregs			hvx_sregs
	lapic_apic_base		int64
	lapic_tsc_deadline	int64
	lapic_reg		array[int32, 64]
	ioapic_ioregsel		int32
	ioapic_id		int32
	ioapic_redir		array[int32, 48]
	pic_mask		array[int32, 2]
	lapic_in_service	int32
	uart			array[int8, 7]
	vblk_desc		int64
	vblk_avail		int64
	vblk_used		int64
	vblk_qsize		flags[hvx_qsize, int32]
	vblk_qready		int32[0:1]
	vblk_last_avail		int32
	vblk_isr		int32
	vblk_irq_vec		int32
	vblk_irq_mode		int32[0:2]
	vblk_irq_pending	int32[0:1]
	vblk_completion_armed	int32[0:1]
	vblk_completion_due	int64
	vblk_status		int32
	vblk_qsel		int32
	vblk_dfeat_sel		int32
	vblk_gfeat_sel		int32
	vblk_gfeatures		int64
	vblk_pci_command	int32
	vblk_pci_bar0		int32
	vblk_pci_cfg_addr	int32
	vblk_pci_intline	int32
	vblk_msix_control	int32
	vblk_config_msix	flags[hvx_msix_idx, int32]
	vblk_queue_msix		flags[hvx_msix_idx, int32]
	vblk_msix_tbl		array[int32, 16]
	fault_seed		int64
	fault_classes		flags[hvx_fault_classes, int32]
	fault_probability	int32
	fault_max_delay		int32
	fault_kick_seq		int32
	fault_req_seq		int64
	fault_count		int64
	vnet_present		int32[0:1]
	vnet_mac		array[int8, 6]
	vnet_pad		const[0, int16]
	vnet_dev_status		int32
	vnet_qsel		int32
	vnet_dfeat_sel		int32
	vnet_gfeat_sel		int32
	vnet_gfeatures		int64
	vnet_pci_command	int32
	vnet_pci_bar0		int32
	vnet_pci_intline	int32
	vnet_isr		int32
	vnet_msix_control	int32
	vnet_config_msix	flags[hvx_msix_idx, int32]
	vnet_msix_tbl		array[int32, 16]
	vnet_desc		array[int64, 2]
	vnet_avail		array[int64, 2]
	vnet_used		array[int64, 2]
	vnet_qsize		array[flags[hvx_qsize, int32], 2]
	vnet_qready		array[int32[0:1], 2]
	vnet_last_avail		array[int32, 2]
	vnet_queue_msix		array[flags[hvx_msix_idx, int32], 2]
	vnet_completion_armed	array[int32[0:1], 2]
	vnet_completion_due	array[int64, 2]
	vnet_irq_pending	array[int32[0:1], 2]
	vnet_rx_head		int32
	vnet_rx_tail		int32
	vnet_tx_len		flags[hvx_txlen, int32]
	vnet_tx_count		int32
	vnet_rx_paced		int32[0:1]
	vnet_pad2		const[0, int32]
	vnet_rx_next_deliver	int64
	nfault_seed		int64
	nfault_classes		flags[hvx_nfault_classes, int32]
	nfault_probability	int32
	nfault_max_delay	int32
	nfault_rx_kick_seq	int32
	nfault_tx_kick_seq	int32
	nfault_pad		const[0, int32]
	nfault_rx_seq		int64
	nfault_tx_seq		int64
	nfault_count		int64
	fx			array[int8, 512]
	pmu_total		int64
	pmu_next		int64
	irr			array[int64, 4]
	xcr0			flags[hvx_xcr0, int64]
	xsave_ext		array[int8, 320]
}
hvx_qsize = 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 256, 0x10000, 0xffffffff
hvx_msix_idx = 0, 1, 3, 4, 0xffff, 0xffffffff
hvx_txlen = 0, 1, 8191, 8192, 8193, 0xffffff00, 0xffffffff
hvx_xcr0 = 0, 1, 3, 7, 0xe7, 0xffffffffffffffff

# ---- the guest program of syz_ext_hvx_guest (every op is 32 bytes: kind, a, b, c) ----
hvx_gop [
	out	hvx_gop_out
	in	hvx_gop_in
	mmio_w	hvx_gop_mmio_w
	mmio_r	hvx_gop_mmio_r
	wrmsr	hvx_gop_wrmsr
	rdmsr	hvx_gop_rdmsr
	cpuid	hvx_gop_cpuid
	insn	hvx_gop_insn
	movcr	hvx_gop_movcr
	raw	hvx_gop_raw
	pci	hvx_gop_pci
	strio	hvx_gop_strio
]

hvx_gop_out {
	kind	const[0, int64]
	port	flags[hvx_ports, int64]
	val	flags[hvx_vals, int64]
	size	flags[hvx_io_size, int64]
}
hvx_gop_in {
	kind	const[1, int64]
	port	flags[hvx_ports, int64]
	unused	const[0, int64]
	size	flags[hvx_io_size, int64]
}
hvx_gop_mmio_w {
	kind	const[2, int64]
	base	flags[hvx_mmio_base, int32]
	off	int32[0:0x8fff]
	val	flags[hvx_vals, int64]
	size	flags[hvx_mem_size, int64]
}
hvx_gop_mmio_r {
	kind	const[3, int64]
	base	flags[hvx_mmio_base, int32]
	off	int32[0:0x8fff]
	unused	const[0, int64]
	size	flags[hvx_mem_size, int64]
}
hvx_gop_wrmsr {
	kind	const[4, int64]
	msr	flags[hvx_msrs, int64]
	val	flags[hvx_vals, int64]
	unused	const[0, int64]
}
hvx_gop_rdmsr {
	kind	const[5, int64]
	msr	flags[hvx_msrs, int64]
	unused	array[const[0, int64], 2]
}
hvx_gop_cpuid {
	kind	const[6, int64]
	leaf	flags[hvx_cpuid_leaf, int64]
	sub	int64[0:3]
	unused	const[0, int64]
}
hvx_gop_insn {
	kind	const[7, int64]
	which	int64[0:24]
	arg	int64
	unused	const[0, int64]
}
hvx_gop_movcr {
	kind	const[8, int64]
	which	int64[0:4]
	val	flags[hvx_crvals, int64]
	unused	const[0, int64]
}
hvx_gop_raw {
	kind	const[9, int64]
	code	ptr64[in, text[x86_64]]
	len	len[code, int64]
	unused	const[0, int64]
}
hvx_gop_pci {
	kind	const[10, int64]
	addr	hvx_pci_addr
	pad	const[0, int32]
	val	flags[hvx_vals, int64]
	ctl	flags[hvx_pci_ctl, int64]
}
hvx_gop_strio {
	kind	const[11, int64]
	port	flags[hvx_ports, int32]
	dir	int32[0:1]
	gpa	flags[hvx_guest_addr, int64]
	count	flags[hvx_counts, int64]
}

# CONFIG_ADDRESS without the enable bit: register, device<<3|function (3 = virtio-blk, 4 = virtio-net), bus
hvx_pci_addr {
	reg	int8
	devfn	flags[hvx_pci_devfn, int8]
	bus	int8[0:1]
	pad	const[0, int8]
}
hvx_pci_devfn = 0x18, 0x20, 0x0, 0x8, 0x19, 0x28
hvx_pci_ctl = 1, 2, 4, 0x101, 0x102, 0x104

hvx_gmem [
	raw	hvx_gmem_raw
	desc	hvx_gmem_desc
	ring	hvx_gmem_ring
]
hvx_gmem_raw {
	gpa	flags[hvx_ring_gpa, int64]
	len	len[data, int64]
	data	ptr64[in, array[int8, 0:512]]
}
hvx_gmem_desc {
	gpa	flags[hvx_ring_gpa, int64]
	len	len[data, int64]
	data	ptr64[in, array[hvx_vring_desc, 1:4]]
}
hvx_gmem_ring {
	gpa	flags[hvx_ring_gpa, int64]
	len	len[data, int64]
	data	ptr64[in, hvx_vring_avail]
}
hvx_vring_desc {
	addr	flags[hvx_ring_gpa, int64]
	len	int32
	flags	int16[0:7]
	next	int16[0:4]
}
hvx_vring_avail {
	flags	int16
	idx	int16[0:4]
	ring	array[int16[0:4], 4]
}
